study type: prospective longitudinal cohort diagnostic accuracy study
cohort: Inborn neonates with a gestational age of 30+6 weeks or younger were consecutively enrolled in this multicenter, international study.
finding: Lung ultrasound scores allow monitoring of lung aeration and function in extremely preterm infants, and gestational age-adjusted scores significantly predict the occurrence of bronchopulmonary dysplasia from the seventh day of life.
